commanderchris__: The new runner gave his name as Otto Commanderchr. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

Otto Commanderchr and Anselm "Parson" Rock divided a parcel using the lid of a tin as scales. The final crumb required a second opinion. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Otto Commanderchr shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Otto Commanderchr tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Otto Commanderchr. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.
fidel_del_toro: Casimir Toro stepped off the supply cart at S-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Casimir Toro answered the first call, number 30 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached S-F12 with the rations. Casimir Toro ate while listening to the revised orders.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Casimir Toro. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Casimir Toro of the Hegemony and Bram Tephydraws of the Concord watched a broken branch near Verdel Ridge all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
just_sharky24: The new rifleman gave his name as Norbert Sharky. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Norbert Sharky shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Norbert Sharky. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him.
A bullet clipped Norbert Sharky's helmet at R-F6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Clement Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424).
w0lfer2210: Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer was a blacksmith in Millbank until the posters went up. He came to S-F3 with a rosary of rough beads, and within a day the whole squad knew that he reads the same book over and over.

Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home found Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer before the night shift. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer folded it small and kept it close.
